name: セピアプテリン還元酵素欠損症

sources.title: Dopa-responsive dystonia due to sepiapterin reductase deficiency

summary.text: Dopa-responsive dystonia (DRD) due to sepiapterin reductase deficiency (SRD) is a very rare neurometabolic disorder characterized by dystonia with diurnal fluctuations, axial hypotonia, oculogyric crises, and delays in motor and cognitive development.

symptoms.text: delays in motor and cognitive development
